contract.problem_to_solve: The manager must finish active work and repair actual dependencies oldest first. Operators need to see the exact queue/admission decision before any live mutation.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Preview covers all 41 approved scenarios, selecting repair prerequisites, queued repairs, Bugs then Stories with correct capacity.
It proposes queueing B only from actual stale parent lineage after A’s full repaired completion; active or Blocked B is left alone.
It preserves old/new unresolved repair roots, recognizes consumed roots and never infers a cascade from order, merge or retargeting.
Paused Epics suppress queue-only and admission decisions; missing lineage or unresolved repair inputs hold instead of admitting unrelated work.

repository.change_boundary: Own cloud-neutral repair selection only; no PR polling, run cancellation or provider writes.
out_of_scope: Plexus/customer code changes
Archived runtime reuse
Activation, worker monitoring, Cursor deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines

accepted_decisions.decision: Story writing and human-invoked request-rework are separate skills.

Pig Boss is the manager. A stream is Jira site + immutable project ID + full label; equal labels in different projects are independent. One customer installation supports multiple projects. Basic manager health is in release one; worker monitoring and scaling implementation remain follow-ons.

constraints.requirement: Own cloud-neutral repair selection only; no PR polling, run cancellation or provider writes.
Return typed decisions for only Ready to Work→In Progress, Rework Queued→In Progress and Human Review→Rework Queued.

environment.target_reference: Current Pigboard PR checkout and prepared disposable local fixtures; no deployed customer target.

fixtures.description: Prescribed isolated fixture set for all cases below; each case states its input and expected outcome. All unmentioned snapshot facts are complete/valid and no earlier-priority work exists.
fixtures.initial_state: Fresh per case; only explicitly sequenced actions share state. Providers/tool receipts are simulated, credentials dummy.

preparation.supplies: Executable local fixtures and exact commands for all human cases below, bound to the PR revision.
preserves: All case inputs, order, expected outcomes, evidence and cleanup. No live provider data or changed test expectations.

human_review.no_ai_cases_reason: Acceptance concerns CLI/IaC or instruction contracts, which the currently approved automated QA skills do not execute. Human reviewers run these cases; developer CI and PR review remain required.

  - id: AC3
    requirement: The source and installed preview explain the conflict with a bounded safe diagnostic, preserve independent coherent scopes, and perform zero writes or authorized execution.

One customer installation supports multiple projects. Basic manager health is in release one; worker monitoring and scaling implementation remain follow-ons.

    - id: TAC2
      requirement: Reuse canonical parsing and validation; preserve public chain inputs/results, strict current authority, existing retention compatibility, receipt/snapshot bounds and PGB-113 resume/resolution/root protections.
    - id: TAC3
      requirement: Compare every common-parser observation identity family before accepting proofs; invalid or unbound receipts grant no authority, and no member of a contradictory group may be accepted by receipt order.
# Testing Strategy

Prepare dependencies before the run.

rows.raw_description:
This same-scope preparation prerequisite supports PGB-78. It preserves the original PGB-78 outcome and cases. Full dispatch remains pending PGB-78; no activation is authorized.

```yaml
schema: pigboard-ticket/v1
problem_to_solve: The prescribed PGB-78 QA cases need complete inputs that the existing helpers and
  publisher can consume without reconstructing missing facts. Current helper preparation needs
  manual completion, while publisher preparation starts with finished assessments.
prerequisites:
  - ticket: PGB-74
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-76
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-77
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-108
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-110
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-138
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    requirement: A developer or human QA reviewer can prepare the declared mixed Story and Bug inputs,
      inspect every artifact and invoke the existing helpers with their exact declared inputs before
      PGB-78 is implemented.
  - id: AC2
    requirement: Preparation preserves requirements, case order, child ownership, declared bindings,
      human cases and negative controls; it supplies no observed result, completed ledger or chosen
      destination.
  - id: AC3
    requirement: Incomplete identity, artifact, extraction, operation or timing facts remain visible
      before execution; existing static, partial and retained-evidence inputs keep their correct
      proof boundaries.
  - id: AC4
    requirement: The existing producer and reviewer guidance explains how to prepare and inspect these
      inputs, retain actual helper evidence and pass an independently formed assessment to qa-jira,
      while full dispatch remains pending PGB-78.
technical_acceptance_criteria:
  repository:
    url: https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard
    base_branch: main
    change_boundary: Complete PGB-78 PREP-01 mechanical input preparation in the existing source-only QA
      fixture module, its tests and producer/consumer guidance; keep existing helper, raw-work,
      prepared_inputs and qa-jira contracts.
    out_of_scope:
      - Plexus/customer code changes
      - Archived runtime reuse
      - Activation, worker monitoring, Cursor deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines
    related_repositories: []
  accepted_decisions:
    - id: D03
      decision: Story writing and human-invoked request-rework are separate skills.
      reference: docs/architecture/manager-human-rework.md
    - id: D04
      decision: Pig Boss is the manager. A stream is Jira site + immutable project ID + full label; equal
        labels in different projects are independent. One customer installation supports multiple
        projects. Basic manager health is in release one; worker monitoring and scaling
        implementation remain follow-ons.
      reference: docs/architecture/pig-boss-operations.md
  constraints:
    - id: TAC1
      requirement: Reuse the existing same-release parsers, receipt validators, fixture exporters and
        installed helper/publisher interfaces without adding a schema, runtime dispatcher, QA engine
        or provider adapter.
    - id: TAC2
      requirement: Keep supplied/mock input facts separate from actual observed outputs and private
        expectations; preserve existing publication fixtures and leave the new output directory
        empty.
    - id: TAC3
      requirement: Bind raw work, trusted context, artifact hashes, actor, tenant, allowed actions and
        current PR/environment proof independently; no missing proof may be replaced by an expected
        value or ticket assertion.
testing_strategy:
  testing_types: []
  environment:
    source: configured_target
    target_reference: Current Pigboard PR checkout and prepared disposable local fixtures; no deployed
      customer target.
    required_capabilities: []
  actors: []
  fixtures:
    - id: DATA-01
      description: Fixed supplied/mock inputs for the three preparation acceptance cases; independent
        variants use fresh private folders.
      initial_state: Fresh per case; only explicitly sequenced actions share state. Providers/tool
        receipts are simulated, credentials dummy.
      reference: null
      preparation_id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
  preparation:
    - id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
      supplies: Executable source-only preparation and exact commands for R1-27-H01 through R1-27-H03,
        bound to the reviewed PR revision and existing helper/publisher interfaces.
      used_by:
        - DATA-01
        - R1-27-H01
        - R1-27-H02
        - R1-27-H03
      preserves:
        - All case inputs, order, expected outcomes, evidence and cleanup. No live provider data or
          changed test expectations.
  dispatch_order: []
  cases: []
  human_review:
    no_ai_cases_reason: Acceptance concerns CLI/IaC or instruction contracts, which the currently
      approved automated QA skills do not execute. Human reviewers run these cases; developer CI and
      PR review remain required.
    cases:
      - id: R1-27-H01
        requirements:
          - AC1
          - AC2
          - AC4
          - TAC1
          - TAC2
          - TAC3
        prerequisites:
          - Prepared same-release checkout and installed helper/publisher roots; fixed native Story
            and Bug mixed API-child, PostgreSQL and UI inputs; dummy access and explicitly
            supplied/mock provider facts.
        steps:
          - Prepare a fresh private input folder with the exact command supplied by PREP-01 and
            record source, installed and input hashes.
          - Inspect raw work/context, declared preparation consumers, selected request/assertions,
            query/parameter layout, UI route/checkpoints, extraction mapping and separate
            access/deployment facts.
          - Invoke each existing helper through its declared caller with actual earlier outputs;
            preserve returned parent/child results, query facts and screenshots.
          - Form an assessment from those actual results and invoke qa-jira with the fixed
            supplied/mock read/write cards; inspect readback and transition evidence.
        expected:
          - Every required input is present and retains its declared type and consumer; an output is
            bound only after its real helper observation.
          - The preparer produces no assessment or verdict; existing helpers and publisher can
            consume the handoff without a new dispatcher or reconstructed fact.
          - Mock evidence stays labelled mock; human cases remain pending and no live mutation
            occurs.
        evidence:
          - Exact commands, source/installed/input hashes, preparation artifacts, original helper
            results, screenshots, independently formed assessment and ordered simulated tool audit.
        execution: human
        owner_role: developer and human QA reviewer
        cleanup:
          mode: prescribed
          reason: null
          owner: human QA reviewer
          steps:
            - Retain inputs, actual output and evidence first; remove only the owned disposable
              preparation folder without changing live records or resources.
      - id: R1-27-H02
        requirements:
          - AC2
          - AC3
          - TAC1
          - TAC2
          - TAC3
        prerequisites:
          - Fresh positive controls and independent missing extraction, query, UI checkpoint,
            identity/tenant, operation-bound and explicit dependency-cause variants; finite
            observation inputs for both completion policies.
        steps:
          - Inspect each positive input with the same delivered contract and validator.
          - Inspect each named negative in a fresh folder and attempt only its existing read-only
            preflight or input validation.
          - Compare unchanged expected outcomes and case/step IDs with the original controls;
            inspect that no expected result or completed output was substituted.
        expected:
          - Positive preparation identifies every fact needed by the existing consumer.
          - Each negative stays incomplete or is rejected at the matching existing boundary; none
            becomes ready through a guessed value, inferred permission or rewritten requirement.
          - Finite observation offsets and whole-unit bounds are supplied as inputs; the preparer
            executes no schedule or mutation.
        evidence:
          - Raw original and negative inputs, parser diagnostics, completeness observations, exact
            missing-field/cause references and empty generated output directories.
        execution: human
        owner_role: developer and human QA reviewer
        cleanup:
          mode: prescribed
          reason: null
          owner: human QA reviewer
          steps:
            - Retain inputs, actual output and evidence first; remove only the owned disposable
              preparation folder without changing live records or resources.
      - id: R1-27-H03
        requirements:
          - AC2
          - AC3
          - AC4
          - TAC2
          - TAC3
        prerequisites:
          - Static human-only Bug, all-NOT_RUN missing-environment partial, earlier FAIL then
            inability, pure upstream wait, retained FAIL plus wait, and valid/invalid
            retained-evidence input controls from the existing publisher families.
        steps:
          - Prepare each independent control and inspect raw requirements and predecessor versus
            current-result separation.
          - Inspect the static pending-human list and the exact proof required by each partial or
            reused claim.
          - Follow the documented existing helper/publisher input handoff and recovery guidance;
            compare the original publication suite before and after preparation.
        expected:
          - Static human-only work requires no invented environment; any supplied PASS/FAIL or
            reused claim retains its actual nonnull tested PR and trusted current-revision
            environment proof.
          - Pure wait and retained-FAIL wait remain distinct and carry a current-case cause; later
            inability preserves earlier findings.
          - Original publication inputs remain unchanged, new execution outputs remain empty, and
            neither preparation nor documentation claims human acceptance or activation.
        evidence:
          - Commands and hashes, original versus emitted input comparison, proof/cause observations,

This dependency wait is not a PGB-147 defect and does not mark acceptance, merge or activation complete. The earlier publication preface and YAML comments below are retained as historical text, not current delivery gates.

rows.raw_description:
R1-38 in the Pig Boss release-one set. This native-only child corrects two demonstrated source observation defects in PGB-150. It targets the pinned source feature branch; PGB-145 is its only native completion prerequisite. Publication does not mean implementation, human acceptance, merge or activation.

# Native title: Read native Jira observations accurately
# Source identity: R1-38; native key assigned only by actual create/readback.
# Reviewed repair plan SHA256: 53ed8317173824d822e2c55f3030837f1ac1e02785228d4470e0bff4b26a789c
schema: pigboard-ticket/v1
problem_to_solve: A caller inspecting a visible issue currently loses its pointer and comments when
  its description is empty. The same caller can receive a false changed-input failure when Jira
  returns an unchanged comment with a different JSON member order. Both failures prevent a truthful
  bounded inspection.
prerequisites:
  - ticket: PGB-145
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    requirement: A named issue with an explicit null description retains that absence and completes its
      requested pointer, comment-page and exact-comment reads when those responses are otherwise
      valid. A missing description remains a response-shape failure.
  - id: AC2
    requirement: An exact comment with the same JSON body value and server metadata completes even when
      root or nested object members arrive in a different order. A changed content-array order or
      existing metadata mismatch remains CHANGED_INPUT; an unmatched exact value is not retained as
      accepted.
  - id: AC3
    requirement: The safe report, private observation boundary, limits, partial-result behavior and
      cleanup remain intact. The source guide explains empty descriptions and semantic comment
      comparison without claiming valid work, complete domain inventory or installed delivery.
technical_acceptance_criteria:
  repository:
    url: https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard
    base_branch: codex/pgb150-source-inspection
    change_boundary: One eight-path child PR corrects explicit null issue descriptions and semantic
      exact-comment comparison in the pinned PGB-150 source feature. It adds four finite source
      regressions, guide and native-only publication support; no source Story is composed.
    out_of_scope:
      - No customer repository, installed bundle, manager state, policy, admission, proof, provider
        probe, activation or new transport/credential path.

    related_repositories: []

        this child as its own prerequisite.
    - id: TAC2
      requirement: Preserve inspectJiraIssues(configInput,{issue_ids,comment_targets},{resolveSecret}),

        TLS, scope restrictions and no-effect controls. Correct only the demonstrated
        issue-description normalization and exact-comment comparison sites.
    - id: TAC3

        unchanged. Add only the four prescribed finite regression subcases through the existing
        importable test fixture API with independent literal observations, counters, cleanup and
        source/input/runtime preservation. Document current effort and native-only repair history
        without claiming complete source/native inventory.

Delivery automations remain inactive.\\\\n\\\\n## Pig Boss release one — approved implementation set\\\\n\\\\nPig Boss is Pigboard's deterministic manager. A company deploys it once into its AWS account for multiple projects in one Jira site. Workstream identity is Jira site + immutable project ID + full label: AI-Maria-1 in two projects represents two independent streams.\\\\n\\\\n## Approved release scope\\\\n\\\\n* One canonical configuration with project-specific mappings, permitted repositories and secret references.\\\\n* Portable scheduling policy and application logic, Jira adapter, DynamoDB scheduling state, thin Lambda wrapper and AWS deployment package.\\\\n* One scan at a time per installation; one responsible installation per project. Multiple independent Cursor streams can run concurrently.\\\\n* Ready to Work Story/Bug selection, queued repairs and stack updates, one occupied automated cycle per project-scoped stream and five Human Review tickets including Bugs.\\\\n* Existing stage webhooks launch workers; separate job/Jira skills produce typed evidence. Human-invoked request-rework remains separate from story writing.\\\\n* Customer-owned basic operating health: read-only readable/JSON inspection, completion freshness, failed/incomplete scans, budget warnings and AWS alarms with optional customer SNS routing.\\\\n* Install disabled, preview, readiness, safe stop/reconciliation, compatible upgrade/rollback/removal; no vendor runtime access.\\\\n\\\\n## Original approved implementation baseline\\\\n\\\\n23 Stories: PGB-71 through PGB-90 plus PGB-99 (company configuration), PGB-100 (health inspection), PGB-101 (AWS health alarms).          \\\\n104 prescribed acceptance cases; 53 product requirements; original 41 scheduling scenarios retained.          \\\\nEstimated effort: 35.25 human working days plus installed acceptance. Each Story is one Pigboard PR, at most 20 changed files and less than two days. Estimates are planning judgments.\\\\n\\\\n[Full ordered plan, sizing and cases](https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard/blob/main/docs/delivery/manager-r1/README.md).\\\\n[Company/health design](https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard/blob/main/docs/architecture/pig-boss-operations.md).\\\\n\\\\nThe revised design and delivery plan have two independent CLEAN reviews each. Native Story contracts were read back exactly after publication. The owner approved the complete 23-Story set on 15 November 2026 and authorized autonomous implementation, per-Story testing/review and merge after current-head CI and Codex bot approval. Execution follows the ordered delivery plan. Story status records progress; no AI execution labels are added. Delivery automations remain inactive.\\\\n\\\\n## Release acceptance\\\\n\\\\nPGB-91 verifies the installed package, including multi-project identity and health lifecycle; PGB-58 verifies actual worker delivery; PGB-92 records the later activation decision. Local checks and historical provider probes do not prove installed acceptance. A second disposable Jira project and any test notification destination need explicit access before that installed test; no resources are created by grooming.\\\\n\\\\n## Follow-on work\\\\n\\\\nPGB-94 is the high-priority path to measured 50-project capacity. Ten is a benchmark step, not a supported-project limit. Measure the workload, optimize safe reads, and only then design partitioning if needed; preserve one installation/configuration and one writer per project.\\\\n\\\\nPGB-95: automatic Jira/Cursor provisioning. PGB-70: worker status visibility. PGB-63 → PGB-64 → PGB-65: launch/cancel feasibility, dispatch design and grooming. PGB-62: human unblock and blocked-stage display. PGB-98: Teams blocker alerts. PGB-60: separate PR environment pipeline. PGB-96: additional QA helpers. PGB-97: other customer-cloud packages.\\\\n\\\\nNo worker heartbeat/transcript collection, Cursor deduplication, dispatcher, automatic recovery, SaaS or old runtime reuse in this release. Basic Pig Boss health is explicitly included.\\\\n\\\\n## History and evidence\\\\n\\\\nPGB-67/68 discovery and PGB-69 baseline grooming remain completed historical records. The isolated provider proof is PARTIAL, not release acceptance. PGB-93 records this approved company/health delta. rows.raw_description:
This same-scope preparation prerequisite supports PGB-78. It preserves the original PGB-78 outcome and cases. Full dispatch remains pending PGB-78; no activation is authorized.

```yaml
schema: pigboard-ticket/v1
problem_to_solve: The prescribed PGB-78 QA cases need complete inputs that the existing helpers and
  publisher can consume without reconstructing missing facts. Current helper preparation needs
  manual completion, while publisher preparation starts with finished assessments.
prerequisites:
  - ticket: PGB-74
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-76
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-77
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-108
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-110
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-138
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    requirement: A developer or human QA reviewer can prepare the declared mixed Story and Bug inputs,
      inspect every artifact and invoke the existing helpers with their exact declared inputs before
      PGB-78 is implemented.
  - id: AC2
    requirement: Preparation preserves requirements, case order, child ownership, declared bindings,
      human cases and negative controls; it supplies no observed result, completed ledger or chosen
      destination.
  - id: AC3
    requirement: Incomplete identity, artifact, extraction, operation or timing facts remain visible
      before execution; existing static, partial and retained-evidence inputs keep their correct
      proof boundaries.
  - id: AC4
    requirement: The existing producer and reviewer guidance explains how to prepare and inspect these
      inputs, retain actual helper evidence and pass an independently formed assessment to qa-jira,
      while full dispatch remains pending PGB-78.
technical_acceptance_criteria:
  repository:
    url: https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard
    base_branch: main
    change_boundary: Complete PGB-78 PREP-01 mechanical input preparation in the existing source-only QA
      fixture module, its tests and producer/consumer guidance; keep existing helper, raw-work,
      prepared_inputs and qa-jira contracts.
    out_of_scope:
      - Plexus/customer code changes
      - Archived runtime reuse
      - Activation, worker monitoring, Cursor deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines
    related_repositories: []
  accepted_decisions:
    - id: D03
      decision: Story writing and human-invoked request-rework are separate skills.
      reference: docs/architecture/manager-human-rework.md
    - id: D04
      decision: Pig Boss is the manager. A stream is Jira site + immutable project ID + full label; equal
        labels in different projects are independent. One customer installation supports multiple
        projects. Basic manager health is in release one; worker monitoring and scaling
        implementation remain follow-ons.
      reference: docs/architecture/pig-boss-operations.md
  constraints:
    - id: TAC1
      requirement: Reuse the existing same-release parsers, receipt validators, fixture exporters and
        installed helper/publisher interfaces without adding a schema, runtime dispatcher, QA engine
        or provider adapter.
    - id: TAC2
      requirement: Keep supplied/mock input facts separate from actual observed outputs and private
        expectations; preserve existing publication fixtures and leave the new output directory
        empty.
    - id: TAC3
      requirement: Bind raw work, trusted context, artifact hashes, actor, tenant, allowed actions and
        current PR/environment proof independently; no missing proof may be replaced by an expected
        value or ticket assertion.
testing_strategy:
  testing_types: []
  environment:
    source: configured_target
    target_reference: Current Pigboard PR checkout and prepared disposable local fixtures; no deployed
      customer target.
    required_capabilities: []
  actors: []
  fixtures:
    - id: DATA-01
      description: Fixed supplied/mock inputs for the three preparation acceptance cases; independent
        variants use fresh private folders.
      initial_state: Fresh per case; only explicitly sequenced actions share state. Providers/tool
        receipts are simulated, credentials dummy.
      reference: null
      preparation_id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
  preparation:
    - id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
      supplies: Executable source-only preparation and exact commands for R1-27-H01 through R1-27-H03,
        bound to the reviewed PR revision and existing helper/publisher interfaces.
      used_by:
        - DATA-01
        - R1-27-H01
        - R1-27-H02
        - R1-27-H03
      preserves:
        - All case inputs, order, expected outcomes, evidence and cleanup. No live provider data or
          changed test expectations.
  dispatch_order: []
  cases: []
  human_review:
    no_ai_cases_reason: Acceptance concerns CLI/IaC or instruction contracts, which the currently
      approved automated QA skills do not execute. Human reviewers run these cases; developer CI and
      PR review remain required.
    cases:
      - id: R1-27-H01
        requirements:
          - AC1
          - AC2
          - AC4
          - TAC1
          - TAC2
          - TAC3
        prerequisites:
          - Prepared same-release checkout and installed helper/publisher roots; fixed native Story
            and Bug mixed API-child, PostgreSQL and UI inputs; dummy access and explicitly
            supplied/mock provider facts.
        steps:
          - Prepare a fresh private input folder with the exact command supplied by PREP-01 and
            record source, installed and input hashes.
          - Inspect raw work/context, declared preparation consumers, selected request/assertions,
            query/parameter layout, UI route/checkpoints, extraction mapping and separate
            access/deployment facts.
          - Invoke each existing helper through its declared caller with actual earlier outputs;
            preserve returned parent/child results, query facts and screenshots.
          - Form an assessment from those actual results and invoke qa-jira with the fixed
            supplied/mock read/write cards; inspect readback and transition evidence.
        expected:
          - Every required input is present and retains its declared type and consumer; an output is
            bound only after its real helper observation.
          - The preparer produces no assessment or verdict; existing helpers and publisher can
            consume the handoff without a new dispatcher or reconstructed fact.
          - Mock evidence stays labelled mock; human cases remain pending and no live mutation
            occurs.
        evidence:
          - Exact commands, source/installed/input hashes, preparation artifacts, original helper
            results, screenshots, independently formed assessment and ordered simulated tool audit.
        execution: human
        owner_role: developer and human QA reviewer
        cleanup:
          mode: prescribed
          reason: null
          owner: human QA reviewer
          steps:
            - Retain inputs, actual output and evidence first; remove only the owned disposable
              preparation folder without changing live records or resources.
      - id: R1-27-H02
        requirements:
          - AC2
          - AC3
          - TAC1
          - TAC2
          - TAC3
        prerequisites:
          - Fresh positive controls and independent missing extraction, query, UI checkpoint,
            identity/tenant, operation-bound and explicit dependency-cause variants; finite
            observation inputs for both completion policies.
        steps:
          - Inspect each positive input with the same delivered contract and validator.
          - Inspect each named negative in a fresh folder and attempt only its existing read-only
            preflight or input validation.
          - Compare unchanged expected outcomes and case/step IDs with the original controls;
            inspect that no expected result or completed output was substituted.
        expected:
          - Positive preparation identifies every fact needed by the existing consumer.
          - Each negative stays incomplete or is rejected at the matching existing boundary; none
            becomes ready through a guessed value, inferred permission or rewritten requirement.
          - Finite observation offsets and whole-unit bounds are supplied as inputs; the preparer
            executes no schedule or mutation.
        evidence:
          - Raw original and negative inputs, parser diagnostics, completeness observations, exact
            missing-field/cause references and empty generated output directories.
        execution: human
        owner_role: developer and human QA reviewer
        cleanup:
          mode: prescribed
          reason: null
          owner: human QA reviewer
          steps:
            - Retain inputs, actual output and evidence first; remove only the owned disposable
              preparation folder without changing live records or resources.
      - id: R1-27-H03
        requirements:
          - AC2
          - AC3
          - AC4
          - TAC2
          - TAC3
        prerequisites:
          - Static human-only Bug, all-NOT_RUN missing-environment partial, earlier FAIL then
            inability, pure upstream wait, retained FAIL plus wait, and valid/invalid
            retained-evidence input controls from the existing publisher families.
        steps:
          - Prepare each independent control and inspect raw requirements and predecessor versus
            current-result separation.
          - Inspect the static pending-human list and the exact proof required by each partial or
            reused claim.
          - Follow the documented existing helper/publisher input handoff and recovery guidance;
            compare the original publication suite before and after preparation.
        expected:
          - Static human-only work requires no invented environment; any supplied PASS/FAIL or
            reused claim retains its actual nonnull tested PR and trusted current-revision
            environment proof.
          - Pure wait and retained-FAIL wait remain distinct and carry a current-case cause; later
            inability preserves earlier findings.
          - Original publication inputs remain unchanged, new execution outputs remain empty, and
            neither preparation nor documentation claims human acceptance or activation.
        evidence:
          - Commands and hashes, original versus emitted input comparison, proof/cause observations,
            exact pending humans, recovery notes and original publication-fixture preservation
            check.
        execution: human
        owner_role: developer and human QA reviewer
        cleanup:
          mode: prescribed
          reason: null
          owner: human QA reviewer
          steps:
            - Retain inputs, actual output and evidence first; remove only the owned disposable
              preparation folder without changing live records or resources.
  automated_regression: Use the existing raw work and receipt validators plus independent artifact
    checks to verify complete helper/publisher input preparation, consumer bindings, preserved
    negative inputs and empty execution outputs.
open_questions: []

rows.summary: Preview own-ticket repairs

contract.problem_to_solve: The local preview waits whenever a ticket has an outstanding repair. Humans and agents need to see when a queued repair on its existing open PR can safely take the next free work slot, before full stack repair ordering is available.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The existing source and installed preview selects a ready own-ticket repair on its existing open PR before unrelated new work, using authenticated requests and completed history from that ticket.

Only unresolved direct requests make a repair eligible; a necessary ready prerequisite takes priority, and occupancy, pause, Blocked work, ownership, intent and the five-item Human Review limit still prevent unsafe selection.

Missing or conflicting evidence and repairs needing stack coordination or a first PR remain a visible safe wait or hold; ordinary current-proof behavior and the existing preview output shape remain compatible.

repository.change_boundary: Own usable own-ticket repair selection in the existing offline preview, its private authenticated history consumer, source and installed checks, guides and the additive delivery publication; one PR in this repository.
out_of_scope: Customer repository changes, provider writes, deployment, activation and live execution
New public inspection commands or output fields
Stack repair propagation, queue-only proposals, first-PR repairs and complete typed proposals, which remain in PGB-81

accepted_decisions.decision: Story writing and human-invoked request-rework are separate skills.

Pig Boss is the manager. A stream is Jira site + immutable project ID + full label; equal labels in different projects are independent. One customer installation supports multiple projects. Basic manager health is in release one; worker monitoring and scaling implementation remain follow-ons.

constraints.requirement: Reuse canonical receipt validation and bounded authenticated history; keep strict current completion as the only prerequisite proof and preserve PGB-113 and PGB-129 authority, conflict and resource protections.
Preserve all original PGB-81 acceptance criteria and 42 full cases; this prerequisite does not complete or weaken that Story.
Keep existing preview JSON fields, readable invocation, installed capability and zero effects; expose no execution authority, new provider client or public inspection interface.

environment.target_reference: Current Pigboard PR checkout and actual same-release installed preview/validator bundle with prepared disposable local fixtures; no deployed customer target.

fixtures.description: Six bounded own-repair selection groups OC01–OC06, derived from the existing PGB-81 case families and immutable authentic receipt chronology, with exact source/installed inputs and full existing-shape expected reports.
fixtures.initial_state: Dummy local data only; no live records, provider credentials or network access; original fixtures and all failed/preparation evidence remain preserved.

preparation.supplies: Freeze the six OC groups in test/fixtures/manager-repairs.json before calls. Derive exact inputs and full expected reports from the preserved chronology and required outcomes, not product output. Independently audit references, operations, current outer binding, target reachability, own request ownership, completed same-ticket assignment lineage, open existing PR, no stack parent, counts and intended gates. Use node scripts/manager-preview.mjs --config CONFIG --input SNAPSHOT --json and the same command without --json; use the actual prepared copied script from unrelated cwd. Prepare dependencies outside the run. OC02 is a finite six-input group: V01 remaining-R2, V02 no remaining cause, V03 implementation-only, V04 review-only, V05 foreign-ticket and V06 unrelated-lineage. Freeze exact provenance and full reports for all six; audit and execute each named variant, with no product-output-derived oracle.
preserves: All immutable original PGB-81 raw inputs, 42 complete case objects, full H02 expectations and existing partial results.
All 66 inherited candidate inputs and expectations, all PGB-129 preview/public-chain/binding fixtures and strict-current compatibility.
Historical evidence remains tied to its tested bytes; no source-installed equality substitutes for an independent full expected report.

expected: The own repair is selected ahead of unrelated new work, without changing its observed assignment, stage, PR or request inventory.

evidence: Exact PR and installed bundle revisions/hashes, commands, complete stdout/stderr/exits, full fixed expectations and input hashes; retain original failures and safe-hold evidence.

cleanup.reason: Read-only local snapshots; retain frozen data and reports. Remove only separately identified disposable installation output after preserving evidence.

prerequisites: DATA-01 contains six separately named frozen OC02 variants, each with coherent native current facts, authorized own requests, a completed current-assignment baseline, current open existing PR, no actual stack parent, complete target closure and all other selection guards valid.
OC02-V01: completed same-ticket A2 consumes exact R1 and the queued lineage retains R1 plus new authorized R2; OC02-V02: the same accounting with only already-consumed R1 required.

OC02-V03: still-unresolved own R1 plus an authentic implementation-only consumption witness, with no completed QA for that witness on the actual current lineage; OC02-V04 uses the corresponding review-only witness.

OC02-V05: still-unresolved own R1 plus authentic foreign-ticket completed evidence sharing the cause through its own request/root lineage; OC02-V06 uses same-ticket completed consumption on a future/divergent assignment outside the current pointer lineage.

steps: Run source JSON and readable preview for OC02-V01, then OC02-V02, using their exact frozen inputs and compare each entire report and input hashes.

expected: V01 selects A for its remaining own repair while retaining R1/R2 evidence; V02 keeps the pending wait with no selection and never invents an empty repair.

V05 and V06 keep R1 actionable and select A because foreign-ticket cause/root overlap and same-ticket completion outside the current lineage cannot discharge the exact own request.

evidence: Exact PR and installed bundle revisions/hashes, commands, complete stdout/stderr/exits, full fixed expectations and input hashes; retain original failures and safe-hold evidence.

prerequisites: Prescribed missing/invalid/conflicting history controls plus stack_update_request, non-null actual stack parent and null/closed/merged/unknown existing PR boundaries from S09 and S23–S28; complete other facts independently.

rows.summary: Inspect named Jira issues safely
rows.raw_description:
Current delivery split (16 November2026): R1-36 / PGB-150 delivers the complete source inspection library and importable fixture API. PGB-147 retains its full acceptance contract and introduces the runnable fixture CLI, installed-runtime delivery and source/copied acceptance. PGB-145 remains a prerequisite and is delivered. PGB-147 is Blocked, waiting on PGB-150 / PR #112 to merge to main and Director's explicit release. Its seven-file checkpoint is archived and parked, not actively implementing; comment 10884 records the exact checkpoint. This dependency wait is not a PGB-147 defect and does not mark acceptance, merge or activation complete. The earlier publication preface and YAML comments below are retained as historical text, not current delivery gates.

Provisional — not ready for delivery. R1-33 in the Pig Boss release-one set. Preparation draft only; no activation is authorized. Actual reviewed/merged PGB-145 rebind and Director publication gates remain.

```yaml
# Provisional — not ready for delivery. No Jira publication or implementation is authorized by this draft.
# Native title: Inspect named Jira issues safely
# Source identity: reserved R1-33; native parent Epic PGB-66. Native key is not allocated here.
# Reviewed plan SHA256: 858c3e8d02a8ae0b3cd810f1e2e00a70dedcd3515cfe18f415a98ef0828f3cb4
schema: pigboard-ticket/v1

# Problem to solve
problem_to_solve: An authorized caller cannot inspect the native issues and comments needed to
  diagnose a manager input. It needs current observations and explicit incomplete results without
  first running a scheduler or discovering a whole project.
prerequisites:
  - ticket: PGB-145
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
  - ticket: PGB-150
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete

# Acceptance Criteria
acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    requirement: A documented source/copied library call inspects the supplied immutable issue IDs,
      their fixed assignment properties, complete comment pages and named exact comments.
  - id: AC2
    requirement: Results identify complete, unavailable and changed observations, retain successful
      observations, and distinguish an unknown pointer from a confirmed value.
  - id: AC3
    requirement: Invalid inputs fail before credential resolution; requests use the fixed HTTPS gateway,
      verified TLS, no redirects or retries, and finite count/byte/time limits.
  - id: AC4
    requirement: Safe human/JSON harness reports show requested completeness, counters and recovery
      without credentials or raw bodies; every result says domain discovery and admission are not
      evaluated.
  - id: AC5
    requirement: The same prescribed inspection works through actual copied dependencies from an
      unrelated directory, with honest setup failure and no source fallback.

# Technical Acceptance Criteria
technical_acceptance_criteria:
  repository:
    url: https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard
    base_branch: main
    change_boundary: Own fixed read-only native issue inspection, its source/copied library and fixture
      harness, distribution, tests, documentation and publication metadata.
    out_of_scope:
      - Plexus/customer repository changes, AWS resolver/wrapper, State adapter and
        operational-state writes.
      - Receipt acceptance, policy selection/admission, external PR/evidence fetching, a new input
        producer or a PGB-144 proof-policy decision.
      - Production live CLI, provider probes, deployment, activation, worker monitoring, Cursor
        deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines.
    related_repositories: []
  accepted_decisions: []
  constraints:
    - id: TAC1
      requirement: Repository `danielchappell/Pigboard`, base `main`, one PR; own the fixed native
        read/inspection library, test harness, distribution and its docs/metadata only.
    - id: TAC2
      requirement: Consume PGB-145's canonical validated connection/bounds and trusted programmatic
        resolver; expose no arbitrary URL, JQL, method, transport module, credential CLI flag,
        environment override or insecure mode.
    - id: TAC3
      requirement: Preserve native IDs/server metadata and endpoint-specific comment pagination; generic
        404, missing pages and visibility limits cannot prove absence.
    - id: TAC4
      requirement: Count all attempted requests and bytes, bound private observations as well as public
        reports, cancel owned I/O and fence late resolver results; return no scheduling or semantic
        receipt proof.

# Testing Strategy
testing_strategy:
  testing_types: []
  environment:
    source: configured_target
    target_reference: Current Pigboard PR checkout, actual prepared copied runtime and disposable local
      HTTPS fixtures; no deployed customer target.
    required_capabilities: []
  actors: []
  fixtures:
    - id: DATA-01
      description: Prescribed isolated B1 fixture set for the four human groups below, including only
        their listed finite variants and controls.
      initial_state: Fresh per variant; only explicitly paired controls share their stated sequence.
        Provider responses are scripted and credentials are dummy.
      reference: null
      preparation_id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
  preparation:
    - id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
      supplies: PR-bound executable local HTTPS fixture scripts, literal reports and permitted request
        traces, exact source/copied commands and prepared absolute paths for every listed variant;
        all expected answers are authored independently of the production collector.
      used_by:
        - DATA-01
        - R1-33-H01
        - R1-33-H02
        - R1-33-H03
        - R1-33-H04
      preserves:
        - All acceptance criteria, technical constraints, case inputs, finite variants and limits,
          paired controls, order, expected outcomes, evidence and cleanup.
        - Existing source/copied distinction, verified TLS and no-effects boundaries; no live
          provider data, changed expectations, new cases or raised budgets.
        - "All original PGB-82 acceptance remains on final82: five AC, three TAC and four human
          groups, including full integrated preview and offline-equivalent policy results."
  dispatch_order: []
  cases: []
  human_review:
    no_ai_cases_reason: Acceptance concerns CLI/library contracts, which the currently approved
      automated QA skills do not execute. QA skills are []; human reviewers run the prescribed
      cases. Developer regressions, CI and independent PR review remain required and do not count as
      human acceptance.
    cases:
      - id: R1-33-H01
        execution: human

        requirements:
          - AC1

        prerequisites:

          - "Run exactly these named variants: complete, empty-comments, renamed-key,

contract.problem_to_solve: An authorized caller cannot inspect the native issues and comments needed to diagnose a manager input. It needs current observations and explicit incomplete results without first running a scheduler or discovering a whole project.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: A documented source/copied library call inspects the supplied immutable issue IDs, their fixed assignment properties, complete comment pages and named exact comments.
Results identify complete, unavailable and changed observations, retain successful observations, and distinguish an unknown pointer from a confirmed value.
Invalid inputs fail before credential resolution; requests use the fixed HTTPS gateway, verified TLS, no redirects or retries, and finite count/byte/time limits.
Safe human/JSON harness reports show requested completeness, counters and recovery without credentials or raw bodies; every result says domain discovery and admission are not evaluated.
The same prescribed inspection works through actual copied dependencies from an unrelated directory, with honest setup failure and no source fallback.

repository.change_boundary: Own fixed read-only native issue inspection, its source/copied library and fixture harness, distribution, tests, documentation and publication metadata.
out_of_scope: Plexus/customer repository changes, AWS resolver/wrapper, State adapter and operational-state writes.
Receipt acceptance, policy selection/admission, external PR/evidence fetching, a new input producer or a PGB-144 proof-policy decision.
Production live CLI, provider probes, deployment, activation, worker monitoring, Cursor deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines.

# Provisional — not ready for delivery. No Jira publication or implementation is authorized by this draft.
# Native title: Inspect complete scoped Jira inventory
# Source identity: reserved R1-34; native parent Epic PGB-66. Native key is not allocated here.
# Reviewed plan SHA256: 858c3e8d02a8ae0b3cd810f1e2e00a70dedcd3515cfe18f415a98ef0828f3cb4
schema: pigboard-ticket/v1

# Problem to solve
problem_to_solve: Named-issue inspection cannot find occupied work omitted from a caller's list. A
  manager caller needs the union of opt-in work, native membership, retained work and typed
  references, with honest limits and ownership changes.
prerequisites:
  - ticket: PGB-147
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete

# Acceptance Criteria
acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    requirement: A source/copied library call returns complete or explicitly incomplete native inventory
      for the configured domain, with retained-source completeness reported separately.
  - id: AC2
    requirement: Discovery covers all-status opt-in seeds, native children and exact full-label
      occupancy, then fresh-reads the union of declared, retained, prerequisite and typed-reference
      identities to a bounded fixed point.
  - id: AC3
    requirement: Missing/drifting/denied reads and exhausted limits retain known observations and
      old/current ownership; failures identify a proven isolated scope or shared uncertainty.
  - id: AC4
    requirement: Immutable project/issue IDs preserve equal-label separation, renamed keys and
      cross-project references; collecting a prerequisite never marks it satisfied.
  - id: AC5
    requirement: The documented source/copied harness demonstrates complete, failure and
      unrelated-history cases without writes, receipt acceptance, state mutation or admission
      claims.

# Technical Acceptance Criteria
technical_acceptance_criteria:
  repository:
    url: https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard
    base_branch: main
    change_boundary: Own complete scoped native inventory and reference collection using B1’s reader,
      with source/copied harness, distribution, tests, documentation and publication metadata.
    out_of_scope:
      - Plexus/customer repository changes, AWS resolver/wrapper, State adapter and
        operational-state writes.
      - Receipt acceptance, policy selection/admission, external PR/evidence fetching, a new input
        producer or a PGB-144 proof-policy decision.
      - Production live CLI, provider probes, deployment, activation, worker monitoring, Cursor
        deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines.
    related_repositories: []
  accepted_decisions: []
  constraints:
    - id: TAC1
      requirement: Repository `danielchappell/Pigboard`, base `main`, one PR; own scoped inventory and
        reference acquisition using B1's fixed reader, with complete docs/distribution/publication
        tests.
    - id: TAC2
      requirement: Use the same single canonical config and invocation accounting. The supplied object has
        exactly retained_members, pending_intents and explicit retained_complete. Retained members
        carry ticket_id, project_id, epic_id, label and assignment (null or
        ticket_id/comment_id/record_id/digest); pending intents carry project_id, label, ticket_id
        and attempt_id. Validate existing bounded field shapes, unique records and configured
        site/project bindings. Missing or false retained completeness never becomes empty complete
        state or new setup authority.
    - id: TAC3
      requirement: Search only fixed enhanced-JQL families; follow actual search tokens and comment
        offsets separately, preserve former ownership and never crawl unrelated project history.
    - id: TAC4
      requirement: Existing work/handoff parsers identify candidate references only; completeness does not
        establish visibility, current receipt proof, trusted context, capacity or policy success.

# Testing Strategy

  testing_types: []
  environment:
    source: configured_target
    target_reference: Current Pigboard PR checkout, actual prepared copied runtime and disposable local
      HTTPS fixtures; no deployed customer target.
    required_capabilities: []

      description: Prescribed isolated B2 fixture set for the four human groups below, including only
        their listed finite variants and controls.
      initial_state: Fresh per variant; only explicitly paired controls share their stated sequence.
        Provider responses are scripted and credentials are dummy.
      reference: null
      preparation_id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
  preparation:
    - id: PREP-01
      owner: implementer
      supplies: PR-bound executable local HTTPS fixture scripts, literal reports and permitted request
        traces, exact source/copied commands and prepared absolute paths for every listed variant;
        all expected answers are authored independently of the production collector.
      used_by:
        - DATA-01
        - R1-34-H01
        - R1-34-H02
        - R1-34-H03
        - R1-34-H04
      preserves:
        - All acceptance criteria, technical constraints, case inputs, finite variants and limits,
          paired controls, order, expected outcomes, evidence and cleanup.
        - Existing source/copied distinction, verified TLS and no-effects boundaries; no live
          provider data, changed expectations, new cases or raised budgets.

contract.problem_to_solve: Named-issue inspection cannot find occupied work omitted from a caller's list. A manager caller needs the union of opt-in work, native membership, retained work and typed references, with honest limits and ownership changes.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: A source/copied library call returns complete or explicitly incomplete native inventory for the configured domain, with retained-source completeness reported separately.

Discovery covers all-status opt-in seeds, native children and exact full-label occupancy, then fresh-reads the union of declared, retained, prerequisite and typed-reference identities to a bounded fixed point.
Missing/drifting/denied reads and exhausted limits retain known observations and old/current ownership; failures identify a proven isolated scope or shared uncertainty.
Immutable project/issue IDs preserve equal-label separation, renamed keys and cross-project references; collecting a prerequisite never marks it satisfied.
The documented source/copied harness demonstrates complete, failure and unrelated-history cases without writes, receipt acceptance, state mutation or admission claims.

repository.change_boundary: Own complete scoped native inventory and reference collection using B1’s reader, with source/copied harness, distribution, tests, documentation and publication metadata.
out_of_scope: Plexus/customer repository changes, AWS resolver/wrapper, State adapter and operational-state writes.
Receipt acceptance, policy selection/admission, external PR/evidence fetching, a new input producer or a PGB-144 proof-policy decision.
Production live CLI, provider probes, deployment, activation, worker monitoring, Cursor deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines.

constraints.requirement: Repository `danielchappell/Pigboard`, base `main`, one PR; own scoped inventory and reference acquisition using B1's fixed reader, with complete docs/distribution/publication tests.

Retained members carry ticket_id, project_id, epic_id, label and assignment (null or ticket_id/comment_id/record_id/digest); pending intents carry project_id, label, ticket_id and attempt_id. Existing work/handoff parsers identify candidate references only; completeness does not establish visibility, current receipt proof, trusted context, capacity or policy success.

rows.raw_description:
R1-38 in the Pig Boss release-one set. This native-only child corrects two demonstrated source observation defects in PGB-150. It targets the pinned source feature branch; PGB-145 is its only native completion prerequisite. Publication does not mean implementation, human acceptance, merge or activation.

# Native title: Read native Jira observations accurately
# Source identity: R1-38; native key assigned only by actual create/readback.
# Reviewed repair plan SHA256: 53ed8317173824d822e2c55f3030837f1ac1e02785228d4470e0bff4b26a789c
schema: pigboard-ticket/v1
problem_to_solve: A caller inspecting a visible issue currently loses its pointer and comments when
  its description is empty. The same caller can receive a false changed-input failure when Jira
  returns an unchanged comment with a different JSON member order. Both failures prevent a truthful
  bounded inspection.
prerequisites:
  - ticket: PGB-145
    required_outcome: ai_qa_complete
acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    requirement: A named issue with an explicit null description retains that absence and completes its
      requested pointer, comment-page and exact-comment reads when those responses are otherwise
      valid. A missing description remains a response-shape failure.
  - id: AC2
    requirement: An exact comment with the same JSON body value and server metadata completes even when
      root or nested object members arrive in a different order. A changed content-array order or
      existing metadata mismatch remains CHANGED_INPUT; an unmatched exact value is not retained as
      accepted.
  - id: AC3
    requirement: The safe report, private observation boundary, limits, partial-result behavior and
      cleanup remain intact. The source guide explains empty descriptions and semantic comment
      comparison without claiming valid work, complete domain inventory or installed delivery.
technical_acceptance_criteria:
  repository:
    url: https://github.com/danielchappell/Pigboard
    base_branch: codex/pgb150-source-inspection
    change_boundary: One eight-path child PR corrects explicit null issue descriptions and semantic
      exact-comment comparison in the pinned PGB-150 source feature. It adds four finite source
      regressions, guide and native-only publication support; no source Story is composed.
    out_of_scope:
      - No customer repository, installed bundle, manager state, policy, admission, proof, provider
        probe, activation or new transport/credential path.
      - No fixture packet JSON/TLS/harness rewrite, source contract-count change or production
        parser format change.
    related_repositories: []
  accepted_decisions: []
  constraints:
    - id: TAC1
      requirement: Repository danielchappell/Pigboard; this native child targets the pinned PGB-150 source
        feature branch at 95c711999b90b20842dfd172f7966f73c8cfde34 and owns exactly the eight
        reviewed paths. PGB-145 is its sole native ai_qa_complete prerequisite; PGB-150 receives
        this child as its own prerequisite.
    - id: TAC2
      requirement: Preserve inspectJiraIssues(configInput,{issue_ids,comment_targets},{resolveSecret}),
        the existing string/null consumer shape, raw/private byte meanings, validation, credentials,
        TLS, scope restrictions and no-effect controls. Correct only the demonstrated
        issue-description normalization and exact-comment comparison sites.
    - id: TAC3
      requirement: Keep the existing 35-variant packet, eight controls and private-projection case
        unchanged. Add only the four prescribed finite regression subcases through the existing
        importable test fixture API with independent literal observations, counters, cleanup and
        source/input/runtime preservation. Document current effort and native-only repair history
        without claiming complete source/native inventory.
testing_strategy:
  testing_types: []
  environment:
    source: configured_target
    target_reference: Pinned Pigboard PGB-150 source branch at 95c711999b90b20842dfd172f7966f73c8cfde34
      with prepared Node dependencies and disposable local HTTPS fixtures; no live Jira or installed
      runtime.
    required_capabilities: []
  actors: []
  fixtures:
    - id: DATA-01
      description: "Four literal source regression subcases: null-description, missing-description,
        adf-nested-order and adf-array-change. The original 35 variants, eight controls and private
        projection remain unchanged."

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Implementer accepts native Story and Bug assignments, rejects other types, reads current assignment, Epic and stream context, plans at Grok High with one independent High review, then implements at Medium.

accepted_decisions.decision: Story writing and human-invoked request-rework are separate skills.

Pig Boss is the manager. A stream is Jira site + immutable project ID + full label; equal labels in different projects are independent. One customer installation supports multiple projects. Basic manager health is in release one; worker monitoring and scaling implementation remain follow-ons.

constraints.requirement: Own implementer job/Jira separation and bundle entry; preserve current harness controls and minimal automation prompt.

Jira skill uses configured existing Atlassian tools: read pointer and exact receipts, publish/read back one record, recheck inputs, send one allowed directed transition. No automatic mutation retries.
Repair preflight requires the same still-open PR; only documented pre-first-PR dependency wait permits null PR. Changed stage or unknown mutation stops without a competing transition.

object.title: Preview current Jira work with bounded reads

contract.problem_to_solve: Offline decisions are useful only if the operator can compare them with complete current Jira facts. Filtered searches must not make occupied work disappear.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: One canonical configuration supplies site/projects, repositories, native mappings, actors, labels, bounds and secret references; work text cannot override it.
The live read-only preview gathers complete bounded pages, unions current membership/dependencies/lineage with supplied retained IDs and fresh-reads each known issue.
Missing pages, denied/deleted IDs, changed membership or exhausted budgets yield precise incomplete/hold results rather than empty availability.
It resolves typed receipts through the supported provider representation and shows selections without writing Jira or operational state.
Live preview resolves each project mapping and allowed cross-project prerequisites; project identity uses immutable IDs and incomplete shared inventory never yields free capacity.

The live preview composes complete scheduling declarations and recorded proof against exact current native/configured/retained identity, explicitly reporting that worker execution and external PR freshness were not checked.

repository.change_boundary: Own Jira read adapter/config validation; retained IDs are supplied through the state interface when installed, not an editable second customer configuration.
out_of_scope: Plexus/customer code changes
Archived runtime reuse
Activation, worker monitoring, Cursor deduplication, automatic recovery and new QA engines

accepted_decisions.decision: Story writing and human-invoked request-rework are separate skills.

Pig Boss is the manager. A stream is Jira site + immutable project ID + full label; equal labels in different projects are independent. One customer installation supports multiple projects. Basic manager health is in release one; worker monitoring and scaling implementation remain follow-ons.
Owner10906 assigns Pig Boss complete deterministic scheduling and recorded-proof checks; workers retain current applicable execution proof.
Director10909 permits in-stage current fact preparation from existing authority; only the implementer fills declared mechanical slots and every action requires its applicable proof.

constraints.requirement: Own Jira read adapter/config validation; retained IDs are supplied through the state interface when installed, not an editable second customer configuration.
Use configured HTTPS origins, verified TLS, bounded time/requests and no credential-bearing redirects; logs/diagnostics exclude secrets and ticket contents.
Initial operator verification of complete service-account visibility is a prerequisite; searches cannot prove unseen issues do not exist.

Use the selected supported package/configuration and snapshot v2 profile without manager execution-context or external PR/evidence prerequisites; retain complete native lineage, retained identity and uncertainty guards.

Publish supported initial defaults from the prescribed finite source/copied fixture evidence, including count/byte/time bounds and limits; do not claim every parser maximum or a live customer environment is supported.

### Why this order

R1-01/02 deliver usable author checks before the writer depends on them. R1-04 delivers a usable receipt validator shared by workers and manager. R1-05–09 update the existing delivery roles without deploying them. R1-30 first supplies one usable mixed Story packet and precise missing-count/stale-proof controls; R1-27 then completes mechanical QA input preparation for the existing helpers/publisher before R1-08 composes final dispatch; PGB-129 adds no product dependency to this path. R1-25 first corrects the existing canonical chain validator on completed R1-10; R1-26 rejects conflicting current proofs; R1-28 then adds usable own-open-PR repair selection before R1-11 delivers the complete typed/stack preview. R1-10/11 give operators a complete zero-write policy preview; R1-12 connects that preview to current Jira facts. R1-13 runs preview in the customer’s AWS account. R1-14/15 give a tested state API plus inspect/reconciliation commands; R1-16 protects upgrade/removal. Only then does R1-17 enable safe fixture admission, followed by queued repairs and dependent-stack queueing. R1-20 checks the whole pinned release before real acceptance.

Intermediate releases remain usable at their declared boundary: local validation, offline/live preview, disabled AWS preview and operator state inspection. New-work apply is explicitly a fixture/development increment while rework apply is absent; required repairs hold rather than being skipped. No partial chain is enabled for customer delivery. State API contract tests are real consumers of its guarantees; the same API is then used by apply. No archived module is revived.

Shared `config/skill-bundle.json`, package metadata and docs need normal integration/review. The table is a valid serial order; stable IDs are not numerical execution order. ## Author principles assessment

- Intuitive: outcome titles and one review pack explain what ships at each step; request-rework remains separate from writing.
- Discoverable: field errors, complete cases, explicit file bounds and one coverage map expose missing work; Jira remains the queue.
- Delightful: no repeat discovery deployment or manual configuration duplication; local acceptance prepares real rollout instead of repeatedly changing live settings.
- Token saver: deterministic validation/scheduling and bounded receipts reduce agent guesswork; the full evidence ledger is never truncated.
- Secure: customer-owned infrastructure, least permissions, trusted scope and positive-only reconciliation are covered by explicit negative cases.
- Agents are equal: structured inputs/outputs remain primary; human-only acceptance accurately covers CLI/IaC gaps without inventing an installed QA engine.
- Dependable: partial provider proof, local fixtures, installed acceptance, merge and activation remain distinct; unknown side effects stay held.
- Unified configuration: one input generates bindings; skill bundle and version checks stop incompatible partial rollouts.
